slides.title: Behavior of typing.cast
slides.prompt: Does `typing.cast(Type, value)` convert or check the value at runtime?
options: No, it simply returns the value unchanged and is used purely by static analyzers
Yes, it converts the value to the target type at runtime
Yes, it raises a TypeError if the runtime type does not match
No, it deletes the variable if types do not match
slides.correctAnswer: No, it simply returns the value unchanged and is used purely by static analyzers
